name: figma-mcp-go
description: Figma MCP server with full read/write access via plugin bridge — no API token, no rate limits. 65 tools for design automation: styles, variables, components, prototypes, and content.

tools.name: add_variable_mode
tools.description: Add a new mode to an existing variable collection (e.g. Light/Dark, Desktop/Mobile).

tools.name: apply_style_to_node
tools.description: Apply an existing local style (paint, text, effect, or grid) to a node, linking the node to that style.

tools.name: batch_execute_pipeline
tools.description: Execute a batch pipeline of mutation steps in Figma, passing values between steps via $variables.

tools.name: batch_rename_nodes
tools.description: Rename one or more nodes: pass `name` to set the name outright, or find/replace, regex substitution, or prefix/suffix to derive it from the current one.

tools.name: bind_variable_to_node
tools.description: Bind a local variable to a node property so the property is driven by the variable's value.

tools.name: boolean_operation
tools.description: Combine two or more shapes into one: UNION merges them, SUBTRACT cuts the later shapes out of the first, INTERSECT keeps the overlap, EXCLUDE keeps everything but the overlap.

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Clone an existing node, optionally repositioning it or placing it in a new parent.

tools.name: combine_as_variants
tools.description: Combine two or more COMPONENT nodes into a single COMPONENT_SET, so they become variants of one component.

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Convert an existing FRAME node into a reusable COMPONENT.

tools.name: create_component_instance
tools.description: Create an instance of a Component.

tools.name: create_connector
tools.description: Create a Connector line in FigJam.

tools.name: create_node
tools.description: Create a shape on the current page or inside a parent.

tools.name: create_style
tools.description: Create a local style.

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Create a new text node on the current page or inside a parent node.

tools.name: create_variable
tools.description: Create a new variable (design token) inside an existing collection.

tools.name: create_variable_collection
tools.description: Create a new local variable collection with an optional initial mode name.

tools.name: create_vector
tools.description: Create a vector node from SVG markup — the way to bring in an icon.

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete one or more nodes.

tools.name: delete_style
tools.description: Delete a style (paint, text, effect, or grid) by its ID.

tools.name: delete_variable
tools.description: Delete a single variable (provide variableId) or an entire collection and all its variables (provide collectionId).

tools.name: detach_instance
tools.description: Detach one or more component instances, converting them to plain frames.

tools.name: export_frames_to_pdf
tools.description: Export multiple frames as a single multi-page PDF file.

tools.name: export_screenshots
tools.description: Export nodes as images.

tools.name: export_tokens
tools.description: Export all design tokens (variables and paint styles) as JSON or CSS custom properties.

tools.name: find_replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace text content across all TEXT nodes in a subtree.

tools.name: flatten_nodes
tools.description: Flatten nodes into a single vector, merging their geometry and discarding the layer structure.

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: Get dev-mode annotations in the current document or scoped to a specific node.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get the node tree of the current selection, the current page, or every page in the file — `scope` chooses which.

tools.name: get_fonts
tools.description: List all fonts used in the current page, sorted by usage frequency.

tools.name: get_image_bytes
tools.description: Read the original bytes of the images placed on nodes, as base64.

tools.name: get_instance_overrides
tools.description: Get the component properties (variants, booleans, text) of a component instance.

tools.name: get_local_components
tools.description: Get all components defined in the current Figma file.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata about the current Figma document: file name, page count, which page is open, and every page in the file with its ID and name.

tools.name: get_nodes_info
tools.description: Get full details for one or more nodes by ID in one round-trip.

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get the prototype reactions defined on a node.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get the nodes currently selected in Figma, or the set the user pinned in the plugin panel.

tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Get all local styles in the document (paint, text, effect, and grid).

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.description: Get all local variable definitions: collections, modes, and values.

tools.name: get_viewport
tools.description: Get the current Figma viewport: scroll center, zoom level, and visible bounds.

tools.name: group_nodes
tools.description: Group two or more nodes into a GROUP.

tools.name: import_image
tools.description: Place an image in Figma, from a URL or from base64 data.

tools.name: manage_component_properties
tools.description: Define what a component exposes to its instances.

tools.name: manage_page
tools.description: Add, delete, rename, or navigate to a page.

tools.name: manage_plugin_data
tools.description: Read and write your own metadata on a node, stored in the Figma file itself.

tools.name: outline_stroke
tools.description: Convert each node's stroke into a filled vector, so the outline can be edited as a shape.

tools.name: reparent_nodes
tools.description: Move one or more nodes to a different parent frame, group, or section.

tools.name: save_version_checkpoint
tools.description: Save a named version in the Figma file's version history.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Find nodes by name substring, by type, or both — omit query to take every node of the given types, omit types to search by name alone.

tools.name: set_annotations
tools.description: Set Dev Mode Annotations on one or more nodes.

tools.name: set_auto_layout
tools.description: Set or update auto-layout (flex) properties on frames, components, component sets, or instances.

tools.name: set_codegen_result
tools.description: Attach generated code to a node so it appears in Figma's Dev Mode Code panel.

tools.name: set_effects
tools.description: Apply one or more effects directly to a node.

tools.name: set_export_settings
tools.description: Set the export presets on nodes — the entries a designer sees under Export in the right-hand panel, and what a Figma export or a handoff pipeline uses.

tools.name: set_instance_overrides
tools.description: Update Component Properties (variants, booleans, text) on a component instance.

tools.name: set_layout_grids
tools.description: Set the layout grids drawn over a frame — columns, rows, or a square grid.

tools.name: set_node_properties
tools.description: Set one or more properties on nodes in a single call: position, size, corner radius, visibility, lock state, opacity, rotation, blend mode, constraints, z-order, masking, and stroke geometry.

tools.name: set_paint
tools.description: Paint a node's fill or stroke.

tools.name: set_reactions
tools.description: Set or remove prototype reactions on a node.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Select nodes in Figma and scroll the viewport to them, switching pages if needed.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Update the text content of an existing TEXT node, and the settings that apply to the node as a whole — wrapping, truncation, alignment, and paragraph spacing.

tools.name: set_text_ranges
tools.description: Style parts of a TEXT node independently: a bold word, a coloured phrase, a hyperlink, a bulleted list.

tools.name: set_variable_value
tools.description: Set a variable's value for a specific mode.

tools.name: swap_component
tools.description: Swap the main component of an existing INSTANCE node, replacing it with a different component while keeping position and size.

tools.name: ungroup_nodes
tools.description: Ungroup one or more GROUP nodes, moving their children to the parent and removing the group.

tools.name: update_paint_style
tools.description: Update an existing paint style's name, color, or description.
